EPFL N-Pulse

Code that
becomes movement.

In progress · Since Sep 2026

Prosthetics / Embedded systems

Prosthesis movement on STM32

As a firmware engineer with EPFL N-Pulse, I’m working on the movement of a prosthesis by programming STM32 microcontrollers.

This work is at an early stage. My focus is on developing the embedded software that connects code to physical movement, while building practical experience with the system.

FPV drone

Hardware / Integration

Building & flying an FPV drone

A personal project taking a drone from individual components to flight: hands-on assembly, soldering and piloting.

Working on a physical system brings together the parts of engineering I enjoy: understanding how components fit together, solving practical problems and seeing the result in action.

Research & academic projects

EPFL · 2024–2025
03
Machine learning

Predicting mouse behaviour from neural activity

2025+

Built models to predict stimuli and behavioural responses from neural activity recordings. Compared linear and non-linear approaches using cross-validation, including ridge regression, random forests and gradient boosting.

Neural dataRegressionCross-validation
04
Bachelor’s project · Laboratory of Sensory Processing

Modelling how mice learn

Project grade 6 / 6
2025+

Research project at EPFL’s Brain Mind Institute, in Prof. Carl Petersen’s Laboratory of Sensory Processing. Enhanced a Python simulation inspired by learning mechanisms in mice, evaluated its limitations and implemented new algorithms and features to better capture behavioural adaptation.

PythonSimulationBehavioural modelling
05
Structural mechanics

Simulating material failure under stress

2025+

Implemented a calculation algorithm to determine when materials fail under stress. Documented the code structure and physical assumptions in a LaTeX report.

Numerical modellingMechanicsLaTeX
06
Applied software engineering

Associative memory with Hopfield networks

2024+

Implemented a Hopfield neural network to retrieve stored patterns from perturbed inputs. Simulated synchronous and asynchronous dynamics to study convergence behaviour.

Neural networksAssociative memorySoftware engineering
07
Object-oriented programming

Agent-based mouse population simulation

2024+

Created an agent-based simulation of a mouse habitat, modelling the mouse life cycle and the spread of disease.

Object-oriented programmingAgent-based modellingSimulation
